acceptance_checks.given: a project with no Magicite state
acceptance_checks.when: Config resolves its paths and ensure_dirs() runs
acceptance_checks.then: registry_dir, archive_dir, approvals_dir, runtime_dir, toml_path and the bench query path all resolve under <project_root>/.magicite/ and are created there, with nothing created under the legacy directory

acceptance_checks.given: a project whose only Magicite state is a legacy .spectra/engrams/ directory
acceptance_checks.then: it resolves to the legacy .spectra/ tree so the registry keeps working, and reports that it did so via uses_legacy_layout

acceptance_checks.given: a project with no Magicite state but an ESL .spectra/changes/ tree
acceptance_checks.then: it chooses .magicite/ — a fresh project is not dragged onto the legacy layout by ESL's own directory
that value wins over both the default and the legacy fallback

acceptance_checks.given: a project on the legacy layout
acceptance_checks.then: it emits a distinct, actionable deprecation finding naming both the current and the intended directory, and the report is not healthy

acceptance_checks.given: this repository's own registry moved to .magicite/engrams/
acceptance_checks.when: the index is rebuilt and the dogfood guards and session run
acceptance_checks.then: sync reports 30 engrams with zero validation errors and zero dangling edges, both dogfood_graph_check checks pass, and the 16-tool session completes with 4/4 probes in top-3
acceptance_checks.verify_method: uv run magicite sync --project-root . && uv run python scripts/dogfood_graph_check.py && uv run python scripts/dogfood_session.py

acceptance_checks.then: ruff check ., mypy src, pytest --cov-fail-under=70 and pytest -m acceptance all pass and magicite tools reports exactly 16 tools, with no assertion weakened to accommodate the move
acceptance_checks.verify_method: uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy src && uv run pytest -q --cov=src/magicite --cov-fail-under=70 && uv run pytest -q -m acceptance && uv run magicite tools

acceptance_checks.given: the docs, container files and CI
acceptance_checks.then: no user-facing instruction still tells a reader to use .spectra/ for Magicite state, and .dockerignore excludes both directories from the build context
acceptance_checks.verify_method: grep sweep recorded in verification-note.md; container smoke tests re-run against a locally built image
